overview.name: Cohen & Steers Real Assets Active ETF
overview.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by allocating at least 80% of its net assets to U.S. and non-U.S. investments providing exposure to or investment in the following real asset classes: (i) real estate companies, including real estate investment trusts (“REITs”); (ii) commodities; (iii) natural resource companies; (iv) infrastructure companies; and (v) gold and other precious metals. It is non-diversified.
